title: Africa coverage evidence tranche 1D - Ghana, Guinea

safety.message: This pack onboards current official sources and creates pending proposals only. Independent review, fresh monitoring, and human-published verified rules remain required.

references.evidence_summary: The Ghana Immigration Service operates the official Ghana Electronic Visa Portal at evisa.immigration.gov.gh for online visa applications.
The Police aux Frontieres (PAF) of the Republic of Guinea operates the official e-visa page at paf.gov.gn/visa for electronic visa applications and entry requirements.

batch.name: v10.22.8 Africa evidence tranche 1D - GH, GN
batch.notes: Official-source evidence for Ghana (GH) and Guinea (GN). Ghana's official e-visa portal is operated by the Ghana Immigration Service. Guinea's official e-visa page is operated by the Police aux Frontieres (PAF). Both endpoints were locally probed from the API container and returned HTTPS 200 responses with usable immigration/visa content. Gabon (GA) remains blocked by TLS certificate validation from the previous tranche. Gambia (GM) and Guinea-Bissau (GW) were deferred because a confirmed reachable official source was not yet identified. Every proposal requires independent human review.

immigration_assessment.evidence_title: Ghana e-Visa - official Ghana Immigration Service portal
immigration_assessment.rationale: The Ghana Immigration Service operates the official Ghana Electronic Visa Portal at evisa.immigration.gov.gh, which enables online visa applications and publishes visa service information. This supports a proposal that Ghana directly administers the relevant immigration rules.

source_onboarding.evidence_notes: Locally probed on 2026-07-17 with status local_probe_passed. The Ghana Immigration Service operates the official Ghana Electronic Visa Portal at evisa.immigration.gov.gh. The page includes structured GovernmentService JSON-LD identifying the Ghana Immigration Service as the provider. Keep the initial certification limited to the visa and entry functions explicitly described. Submission creates pending proposals only; independent reviewer certification remains required.

immigration_assessment.evidence_title: Guinea e-Visa - official Police aux Frontieres visa page
immigration_assessment.rationale: The Police aux Frontieres (PAF) of the Republic of Guinea operates the official e-visa page at paf.gov.gn/visa, which enables electronic visa applications and describes entry requirements. This supports a proposal that Guinea directly administers the relevant immigration rules.
